Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations.
  
  
Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. * Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack

* Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds

**Summary**
Content Solutions Engineering, part of Apple’s IS&T organization, builds and maintains the Content Management systems — including Digital Asset Management (DAM) — that empower Apple’s business teams to author, manage, and publish content across a wide range of channels. We build the systems that sit behind every piece of content Apple’s customers and employees interact with, at scale and with high reliability. We’re looking for a backend engineer who is passionate about building resilient, high-throughput systems that make it effortless for content teams to manage, discover, and deliver digital assets across Apple’s ecosystem.
  
  
**Description**
You will design, build, and operate backend services for our Digital Asset Management platform, working closely with content, publishing, and platform engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable systems that power content authoring and delivery across Apple’s public and internal properties.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and build scalable backend services and APIs for asset ingestion, transcoding, metadata management, and taxonomy services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build and operate high-throughput ingestion and transcoding pipelines that process a wide variety of digital asset types at scale.
* Design and implement search and retrieval APIs for digital assets, leveraging Solr/Elasticsearch for fast, relevant asset discovery.
* Develop and maintain rights and licensing enforcement mechanisms to ensure assets are used and distributed in compliance with content policies.
* Integrate DAM services with upstream and downstream content workflows, enabling seamless authoring-to-publish experiences across channels .
* Work with data stores such as MongoDB and DynamoDB to design efficient, scalable data models for asset metadata and taxonomy.
* Use Kafka to build event-driven, resilient pipelines connecting ingestion, processing, and downstream consumption of assets.
* Deploy and operate services on AWS, using EKS for container orchestration in a large-scale, highly available environment.
* Optimize storage and CDN usage to ensure fast, cost-effective delivery of digital assets across Apple’s global audience.
* Explore and apply AI-driven and agentic approaches — such as AI-assisted metadata tagging, agentic workflows, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — to improve content operations and reduce manual toil.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional engineering, content, and product teams, communicating clearly and effectively to align on requirements and trade-offs.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design discussions, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on backend or distributed systems.
* Programming skills in Java, with hands-on experience building services using Spring Boot.
* Experience building or operating Digital Asset Management systems, content management systems, or media processing/transcoding pipelines.
* Experience working on metadata and search layer: schema modeling, controlled vocabularies, faceted query APIs, and metadata extraction from embedded sources .
* Experience building rendition and derivative generation services — thumbnails, previews, web-optimized variants — orchestrated asynchronously at scale
* Experience designing and building REST APIs for high-throughput, production-grade systems
* Experience with NoSQL data stores such as MongoDB and/or DynamoDB, including schema/data modeling for scale.
* Experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming/messaging systems.
* Experience with search technologies such as Solr or Elasticsearch.
* Experience deploying and operating services in containerized, cloud environments (AWS, EKS/Kubernetes).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Experience with metadata and taxonomy design for large-scale content or asset repositories.
* Hands-on experience or interest in AI/agentic tooling — such as AI-driven metadata tagging, agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, or building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — applied to real engineering use cases.
* Experience with CDN configuration and storage optimization for content delivery at scale.
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading projects or technical design discussions.
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**WHO WE ARE:**

Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service — a subscription model in which we take over a client’s procurement function entirely.

We run three companies across India, Hong Kong and the UAE. We are bootstrapped, no outside funding and none being sought, and people here own real things early.

**THE ROLE:**

**We are hiring three full-stack engineers to join our in-house engineering team. There are two senior engineers here already. The three of you would make it a team of five, and between you that team is responsible for everything this company runs on.**

The main build is the SCaaS platform — the software the subscription business runs on, and the system our clients use. Broadly it covers the client-facing side where a customer raises a requirement and watches it move; the sourcing side where suppliers are matched, quotes compared and decisions recorded; and the operations side underneath — fulfilment, documentation, landed cost, and the integrations that keep everything in step.

**Which part you own is decided after you join, not before.**

Five engineers carrying three platforms is a broad surface for a small team. You will context-switch more than you would at a larger company, you will work outside whatever you consider your specialism, and some weeks the priority will change under you.
